mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", step_id AS "stepId", amount_formula_key AS "amountFormulaKey", value_policy_type_id AS "valuePolicyTypeId", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.heal_effect_details WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND step_id = #{stepId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.heal_effect_details (game_id, step_id, amount_formula_key, value_policy_type_id, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{stepId}, #{amountFormulaKey}, #{valuePolicyTypeId}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, step_id) DO UPDATE SET amount_formula_key = EXCLUDED.amount_formula_key, value_policy_type_id = EXCLUDED.value_policy_type_id, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", step_id AS "stepId", amount_formula_key AS "amountFormulaKey", value_policy_type_id AS "valuePolicyTypeId", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.heal_effect_details WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, step_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.heal_effect_details_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, step_id, amount_formula_key, value_policy_type_id ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, step_id, amount_formula_key, value_policy_type_id FROM public.heal_effect_details WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, step_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, amount_formula_key = EXCLUDED.amount_formula_key, value_policy_type_id = EXCLUDED.value_policy_type_id
